description: A mounted battle in a rocky mountain valley. On the left, a bearded man in beige robes and a white turban rides a dark horse and thrusts a long lance, with a round shield on his arm. On the right, a rider in scale armour and a conical helmet on a chestnut horse raises a lance. Behind them more riders with pennants and spears fill a dusty ravine. In the foreground a red and gold patterned cloth lies on the ground, pierced by a spear. No visible text, border or frame.
